protocol.title: Digital Quantification of Proteins and mRNA in Single Mammalian Cells
protocol.platform: Digital PLA (proximity ligation assay) + droplet digital PCR (ddPCR) + two-step RT-ddPCR; bench-top microfluidic droplet platform (Bio-Rad QX100)
cell_lines: HEK293T (human embryonic kidney; Tlr4-GFP stable, gift from Prof. Kensuke Miyake)
protocol.objective: Absolute and simultaneous quantification of CD147 protein (digital PLA) and CD147 mRNA (two-step RT-ddPCR) copy numbers from the same single mammalian cell; parameterisation of a stochastic two-state model of gene expression

rt_ddpcr.primer_probe: TaqMan Gene Expression Assay Hs00174305_m1 (Probe 2; FAM/MGB; exon-exon spanning)

reagents.lysis_buffer: 0.1X TM lysis buffer (10-fold diluted TM Buffer, Biochain) + protease inhibitor cocktail (Biochain) + CRB (Cell Resuspension Buffer, Life Technologies) + RNaseOUT (Invitrogen)

proximity_probes.CD147: Biotinylated anti-human CD147 polyclonal goat antibody (R&D Systems, BAF972); oligonucleotide-conjugated; 400 pM each probe stock, 200 pM final
proximity_probes.GFP: Biotinylated anti-GFP polyclonal goat antibody (Abcam, AB6658)
proximity_probes.ICAM1: Biotinylated anti-murine ICAM-1 polyclonal goat antibody (R&D Systems, BAF796)

reagents.connector_oligonucleotide: Custom DNA oligo (Microsynth, Switzerland); hybridises to both proximity probe oligonucleotides to template ligation
reagents.ligation_solution: T4 DNA ligase + ligation buffer; 25-fold dilution of probe-bound sample
reagents.protease_solution: Diluted protease (Life Technologies TaqMan Protein Assay); inactivated at 95 C for 15 min
reagents.rt_system: GoScript Reverse Transcription System (Promega); random primers, dNTPs 0.5 mM each, MgCl2 3.1 mM, 1 U/uL RNaseOUT

protein_standards.CD147: Human CD147 recombinant protein (R&D Systems, 972-EMN); diluted in 0.1X TM buffer or LDB
protein_standards.GFP: Pure GFP protein (Abcam, AB84191); diluted in 1X PBS
protein_standards.ICAM1: Pure murine ICAM-1 (R&D Systems, 796-IC); diluted in 1X PBS

reagents.containers: Low-adsorption 8-well PCR strips (Thermo Fisher, AB-0266); 1.5 mL low-adsorption microfuge tubes (Ambion, AM12450)

HEK293T.media: High-glucose DMEM (Gibco, 41965-039) + 10% FCS (Gibco, 26010-066) + 100 U/mL penicillin G + 100 ug/mL streptomycin sulfate (Gibco, 15070063)
HEK293T.conditions: 37 C, 5% CO2; passage every 3-4 days to 1e5 cells/mL; max 30 passages
HEK293T.sort_marker: Tlr4-GFP fusion protein (DRAQ7 for viability; R4 gate)

RAW264.7.media: DMEM (Sigma, D6429) + 8.8% FBS (Sigma, F9665) + 0.88X GlutaMAX + 17.7 mM HEPES
RAW264.7.conditions: 37 C, 5% CO2; passage every 2-3 days to 1e5 cells/mL; max 15 passages
RAW264.7.reporter: GFP-p65 h2b-mCherry dual fluorescent stable line; sorted by FACS (GFP/mCherry gates)

facs_sorting.viability_dye: DRAQ7 (BioStatus, DR71000) at 600 nM; stains dead cell nuclei
facs_sorting.sort_target_HEK293T: Single viable Tlr4-GFP cells; 4 nested gates (SSC-H/FSC-H, SSC-H/SSC-W, FSC-H/FSC-W, DRAQ7/GFP)
facs_sorting.sort_target_RAW264.7: Single viable GFP-p65 mCherry+ macrophages; 3 nested gates (FSC/SSC, DRAQ7/FSC, GFP/mCherry)
facs_sorting.storage: Sealed with clear adhesive sheet + Parafilm; -80 C until processing

steps.name: Single-cell FACS sort and lysis
steps.notes: Single cell sorted by FACS into 3 uL 0.1X TM buffer in 8-well PCR strip; plate centrifuged briefly, sealed, stored at -80 C. 0.1X TM buffer is compatible with both digital PLA and RT-ddPCR (confirmed in Fig S4G-H). BioScript mix duration: 5m (300s in IR).

steps.name: Lysate split: protein fraction (2 uL) and mRNA fraction (1 uL)
steps.operation: split 1:2 (abstracted as two independent dispense+mix events in BioScript)
steps.notes: Physical 1:2 split; protein fraction (2 uL) into digital PLA arm; mRNA fraction (1 uL) into RT-ddPCR arm. BioScript has no native ratio-split; modelled as two variables (proteinLysate, mRNALysate) derived from lysate. LOD for CD147 protein in 2 uL fraction: 29,300 molecules/cell.

steps.name: Proximity probe adsorption
steps.notes: Both proximity probes (anti-CD147 antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates) combined in assay probe solution; bind distinct CD147 epitopes simultaneously. When bound to same molecule, oligonucleotides come into ~40 nm proximity enabling connector hybridisation. BioScript: heat at 37c for 60m (IR: 3600.0 SECOND).

steps.name: Connector oligonucleotide hybridisation and ligation
steps.notes: 96 uL ligation solution added to 4 uL probe-bound sample (25-fold dilution). Connector oligo hybridises to paired probe oligonucleotides; T4 ligase seals nicks forming dsDNA. dsDNA molecule encodes one protein detection event. BioScript: heat at 37c for 10m (IR: 600.0 SECOND).

steps.name: Protease digestion and inactivation
steps.notes: Protease digests antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates, leaving only dsDNA amplicons in solution. Inactivated at 95 C for 15 min. BioScript: heat at 37c for 10m then heat at 95c for 15m (IR: 600.0 SECOND, 900.0 SECOND).

steps.name: ddPCR droplet generation and amplification (protein)
steps.readout: QX100 Droplet Reader + QuantaSoft v1.3.2.0 Absolute Quantification; threshold set from most concentrated standard
steps.notes: Positive droplets contain one amplified dsDNA molecule (fluorescent); negative droplets do not. Concentration: C = (1000/Vd) * ln(1 - P/R). Absolute protein count from calibration curve. BioScript: three sequential heat steps (95c/10m, 94c/35m, 98c/10m). IR: 600s, 2100s, 600s.

steps.name: Protein ddPCR detection and QC gate

pass.interpretation: CD147 protein detected above LOD (29,300 molecules/cell)

fail.interpretation: Below LOD; cell had insufficient CD147 protein

expected_results.single_cell_range: 35,900 to 636,000 CD147 proteins per cell (138 HEK293T cells)

steps.name: RT primer annealing
steps.notes: RNA secondary structure denatured at 70 C for 5 min; immediately chilled on ice (4 C, 5 min) to prevent re-folding before RT. BioScript: heat at 70c for 5m then heat at 4c for 5m (IR: 300.0 SECOND each).

steps.name: Reverse transcription (cDNA synthesis)
steps.recovery_validation: T7 in-vitro transcribed CD147 mRNA standard measured by A260 vs RT-ddPCR (y=0.876x, R2=0.988); all single-cell reads corrected by 0.876 factor
steps.notes: BioScript: heat at 25c for 5m, heat at 42c for 60m, heat at 70c for 15m (IR: 300s, 3600s, 900s).

steps.name: ddPCR amplification of cDNA (mRNA)
steps.taqman_assay: Hs00174305_m1 (Probe 2); FAM/MGB; exon-exon junction spanning; excludes genomic DNA
steps.notes: BioScript: heat at 95c for 10m, heat at 94c for 35m, heat at 98c for 10m (IR: 600s, 2100s, 600s). Concentrations converted to mRNA copies/cell with 87.6% RT recovery correction.

steps.name: mRNA RT-ddPCR detection and QC gate

pass.interpretation: CD147 mRNA detected above corrected LOD (52.5 copies/cell = 87 aM)

fail.interpretation: Below LOD; mRNA undetectable in this cell

expected_results.distribution_fit: Gamma pdf (p=0.65 by chi-squared test); two-state stochastic gene expression

mRNA_protein_correlation.conclusion: Poor correlation at single-cell level; contrasts with bulk estimates (Pearson R = 0.41-0.59). mRNA is a poor surrogate for protein abundance.

distribution_fitting.mRNA_fit: Gamma pdf (shape=alpha, rate=beta); p=0.65 chi-squared goodness-of-fit
distribution_fitting.conclusion: Distributions inconsistent with Poisson (one-step birth-death); consistent with two-state stochastic process

stochastic_model.type: Two-state promoter switching model (Peccoud and Ycart 1995; Paulsson 2005)
stochastic_model.inference_method: Markov-chain Monte Carlo (MCMC); moment-based analysis (Zechner et al. 2012)
stochastic_model.validation_term: E[M(t)P(t)] (mRNA-protein covariance; not used in fitting)
stochastic_model.model_validation: 4 out of 5 experimental repeats: predicted E[M(t)P(t)] agrees with measured correlation

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Cell lysis, lysate split, digital PLA arm (S1-S7), RT-ddPCR arm (S8-S11)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.description: Dispose proteinSignal; mRNA RT-ddPCR arm begins
